input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, user management domain. It serves API Consumer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include a p i usage plans service, account, account service. Core business data revolves around Account, Statistic, Travel, User. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to manage my account settings, so that my preferences and personal data stay under my control.
As a API Consumer, I want to register and authenticate, so that I can securely access my account and protected resources.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage application configuration centrally, so that all services pick up the latest settings without redeployment.
As a API Consumer, I want to search and book travel itineraries, so that I can plan trips with up-to-date availability and pricing.
